note: Voice script + caption plan of a kids review (worked example: 1107 Children, 25 shots of 2 s, 52.2 s). One line per shot, said by host voice 3B. t = start (s, 0.15-0.25 s after the shot's cut); text = what the host says (exact, particles 啦/咯/哦/咧/耶, never a child's name); shot = what is on screen (check every line against it); seg = the line's words separated by spaces, so a caption card never splits a word (regroup_words.py; leave it out to let jieba guess). Every other field goes onto the caption-card plan line as is (makeplan.py): key = the candy key word(s), an exact part of text; kind hook / writeon / punch for the big moments (rows, phrase, color, y = 9:16 height, accent rings|halo, transition flash); punch_in, leak, sway as in the caption-card skill; bubble left|right makes a speech-bubble card (or set it in cute.json).
